import bm from 'bm';

// Per-tab - survives navigation, dies on tab close.
const shell = bm.cache.namespaced('shell', staticAssetVersion);
const cached = shell.get();           // the cached string, or undefined on a miss
if (cached) listEl.innerHTML = cached;   // instant pre-paint

// Then fetch the real data + write back.
const html = renderList(await bm.table('posts').list({ limit: 50 }));
listEl.innerHTML = html;
shell.set(html);

shell.purgeOld();                     // drops all versions of 'shell' except current

// Cross-tab cache - same shape, localStorage backing.
const userPrefs = bm.cache.persistent('prefs', 'v3');
